## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. Taken out of turn (data integrity). Pending edits are keyed by record id

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T05:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1, and out of turn:** a value typed on one record is written to another, with a 200 and no signal. The concurrency token cannot catch it, because the wrong row's token is current. It is silent corruption of user data, and it matches its sibling #12292 (p1). It was measured in jsdom through the real components, not live, which is enough for the mechanism.
- **Direction:**
  - `data-table`'s `PendingChanges` is keyed by the record's id (the row id the grid already resolves), not the page-local index.
  - Every reader of the pending map (cell draw, dirty bar, Save All, single-row save) looks up by id.
  - A re-read that drops a record with a pending edit keeps the edit visible as pending against that id. ⛔ It never moves the edit onto the row now at that index.
  - **Pins:**
    - the card's sequence: edits on two rows, save one so the re-read reorders, then Save All writes each edit to its own record;
    - a re-read via the invalidation bus does the same;
    - a page change keeps a pending edit with its record.
- **Serial:** PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12309 (#12292, in flight) changes `ObjectGrid`'s save functions. This card's fix is in `@object-ui/components`' `data-table`. If the claim finds it must touch the same `ObjectGrid` lines, it lands after #12309. ⛔ Not folded into it.
- Triage: lands in `packages/components/src/` (`data-table`) (`domain:ui`); rationale: an edit belongs to its record.

Claim: PM loop round 5, next slot. The direction is triage `6139302398`: a pending edit belongs to its record.
- `data-table`'s `PendingChanges` is keyed by the record's id (the row id the grid already resolves), not the page-local index.
- Every reader of the pending map looks up by id: cell draw, the dirty bar, Save All and the single-row save.
- A re-read that drops a record with a pending edit keeps the edit pending against that id. ⛔ It never moves the edit onto the row now at that index.

File surface: `data-table`'s pending-edit state, read on objectui `main` `3092aca` (which carries PR objectui#12309) at 2026-10-13T07:22Z. Stop on a breach and explain it in the report.
- **The table:** `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`.
  - `type PendingChanges = Map<number, Record<string, any>>` is keyed by page-local row index.
  - It is read by `pendingRows.of(row, rowIndex)`, `startEdit`, the cell stage paths, `saveRow`, `cancelRowChanges` and `saveBatch`. `saveBatch` resolves each key to `sortedData[...]` at save time.
  - `erroredRows` is a `Set<number>` keyed the same way.
  - `getRowId(row, index)` already resolves `row.id`, falling back to `row-${index}`.
- Co-located tests and a changeset.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is read only, unless the measurement shows the producer of the id is there.
- ⛔ The published callback shapes (`onCellChange`, `onRowSave`, `onBatchSave` and its `{ failed }`) keep their arguments unless the report justifies a change.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason:
- The pending map's key is internal state of the `data-table` renderer.
- The published callbacks keep receiving `rowIndex` (computed at call time) and `row`, so no published type, export or accepted input moves.
- None of the three contract surfaces is touched.
Responsibility: `@object-ui/components' data-table (pending edits keyed by page-local index) | none: the If-Match token from objectui#12309 cannot catch it, because the wrong row's own token is current | every console user who stages inline edits on two or more rows and then sees the page re-read in a new order (a row save's refresh, onMutation, the invalidation bus) or changes page; measured on the card in jsdom through the real ObjectGrid and data-table`
Thread-read: 6139302398
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-13T07:22Z on objectui `main` `3092aca`.
- Triage's serial predecessor, PR objectui#12309, merged as `3092aca`.
- No open PR touches `data-table.tsx` or `plugin-grid/src` (objectui#12313, #11845, #11844 and #11600 read).
- This seat's in-flight devs share no file: objectui#12295 (`data-objectstack`, `app-shell` `layout/`) and objectui#12305 (`app-shell` `console/home/`, `views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx`).
